meta: Every home has rules for phones, but very few have rules for AI. Four simple rules for the whole family: keep private info out, AI helps but doesn't do it for you, check, and tell an adult.

muc.title: House rules for AI
muc.text: Every home has rules for phones, but very few homes have rules for AI.

muc.title: Keep private info out
muc.text: Rule one: don't give AI full names, your home address, photos of friends, or anyone's passwords.

muc.title: AI helps, it doesn't do it for you
muc.text: Rule two: AI helps explain and gives ideas, but homework, birthday wishes and important messages you write yourself.

muc.title: Check, and tell an adult
muc.text: Rule three: check before you believe. Rule four: if AI says something strange or makes your child uncomfortable, tell an adult right away.

muc.title: Stick the rules on the fridge
muc.text: As a family, write these four rules on a sheet of paper, stick it on the fridge, and agree to look at them again in a month.
